name: Stroq
description: Local action firewall for OpenClaw: scans what the agent reads, taints the session, blocks or asks before dangerous tool calls.

stroqBin.label: stroq command
stroqBin.help: Path to the stroq binary. Defaults to `stroq` on PATH, then the path recorded by `stroq init --agent openclaw`.

workspace.label: Project directory
workspace.help: Used for the secret index and path classification. A tool call's own cwd is never used for this — see the plugin README.
